proposed_facts.reason: The complete destruction callback ignores its argument and calls only Camera_StopQuake(Small); the canonical callee clears the corresponding global remaining-frame counter.
Canonical entry and reveal calls distinguish Medium from Small. Destruction stops only Small explicitly, supporting the narrower cleanup explanation.
The Kabigon registry entry binds this destruction callback and the table containing all three motion states; Logic2 is not a second chronological phase.
Local collision always returns false, but shared processing has separate movement and boundary-destruction paths. Initialization enables b3 and activation selects mask 0xE.
The mask write and ordered calls match canonical source. Shared consumers map 0xE to right, left and bottom checks, excluding the mask-1 high-Y check.
Item_80268E5C clears accessory and hitlag slots before state-0 entry reinstalls them and requests Medium. The stated registration lifetime follows the shared reset.
The command gate, predecrement, exact-zero emission and reload are explicit. State-1 entry clears the accessory through the shared state change and does not reinstall it.

The helper copies position, offsets x and y with successive HSD_Randf samples and preserves z. The generator produces 16-bit-derived samples in [0,1); sign and finite-precision qualifications appropriately replace unconditional radius bounds.

contradictions.reason: Accept the four section-fact deferrals and the .sdata2 link deferral. Three source initializers and visible literal consumers cannot establish compiled byte sizes, entry layout, small-data placement or section-to-literal attribution.

Resolve the exclusive animation-termination claim and camera-mode description through proposed facts 3 and 4: independent shared boundary destruction remains possible, and activation requests Medium quake rather than an unspecified camera mode.

Resolve the state-entry and accessory explanations through proposed facts 5 and 6. Shared state changes clear registrations; state 0 installs the accessory afterward, whereas state 1 does not. Expiry is exact zero after decrement, not a nonpositive test.

Resolve the overprecise random-range claim through proposed fact 7. The formula is supported, but unvalidated radius sign and floating-point evaluation preclude an unconditional exact half-open output bound or independence guarantee.

Resolve both obsolete destruction-camera explanations through proposed facts 0 and 1. Canonical behavior is an unconditional global Small-quake timer clear, not an unspecified selector notification or comprehensive quake cleanup.

Resolve the chronological Logic2 interpretation through proposed fact 2. One Kabigon registry entry owns the complete motion table and destruction hook. Existing supported rendered names and retained knowledge are preserved; no reviewer override is needed.
